testsuite.name: com.crush.mobile.ui.screens.chat.QuestionDialogTest

testcase.name: submit stays disabled until every prompt is answered
single choice submits the selected id
a new batch does not inherit an in-flight operation
a replacement batch starts with no selection from the old batch
multi choice submits every selected id
an unanswerable prompt disables submit but cancel remains
operations in flight disable submit and cancel
